title: Transformers with Signatures: Towards Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.31439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables transformers to adapt to new tasks from demonstrations without updating their parameters. However, theoretical guarantees for transformers remain limited in general, and elusive in particular when target responses depend nonlinearly on the evolution of observed paths. We establish an ICL framework for path space, using path signature features. Building on the universal linear approximation property of signatures, we construct explicitly a causal softmax transformer with two attention heads per layer that emulates in-context Lasso. Under sparse signature approximation and suitable moment and concentration conditions, we establish finite-sample prediction error bounds. Our analysis goes beyond the IID data setting in the existing ICL theory, allowing dependence among demonstrations and the query. translated_title: 带签名的Transformer：迈向路径空间中的通用上下文学习
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）使Transformer能够通过演示样例适应新任务，而无需更新其参数。然而，针对Transformer的理论保证在一般情况下仍然有限，尤其是当目标响应非线性地依赖于观测路径的演化时，更是难以获得。我们利用路径签名特征，建立了一个面向路径空间的上下文学习框架。基于签名的通用线性逼近性质，我们显式构造了一个每层具有两个注意力头的因果softmax Transformer，用以模拟上下文Lasso。在稀疏签名近似以及适当的矩和集中性条件下，我们建立了有限样本预测误差界。我们的分析超越了现有上下文学习理论中的IID数据设定，允许演示样例与查询之间存在依赖关系。在上下文稀疏恢复、非线性路径回归、执行成本预测和金融（数据）上的实验……
tldr: 该论文利用路径签名特征建立了面向路径空间的上下文学习理论框架，显式构造了可模拟上下文Lasso的每层双注意力头因果softmax Transformer，并给出超越IID数据设定的有限样本预测误差界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes an in-context learning framework on path space using path signature features, explicitly constructs a causal softmax transformer with two attention heads per layer that emulates in-context Lasso, and derives finite-sample prediction error bounds beyond the IID data setting.
